issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect an instance method named swiftExperienceDescription() on Developer (the template provides a stub for extension Developer { func swiftExperienceDescription() -> String { ... } } and the problem text explicitly names swiftExperienceDescription()). In the solution repository the Developer extension instead defines getExperienceDescription(), and the solution's initializer calls getExperienceDescription(). Meanwhile the solution's Client calls myself.swiftExperienceDescription() and profKrusche.swiftExperienceDescription(). This name mismatch across files (solution's Developer vs solution's Client and the problem/template) is a structural inconsistency: the solution is internally inconsistent and does not provide the method name the Client expects. It will cause compilation errors and will confuse students trying to reconcile the solution with the problem and template.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Rename the solution's getExperienceDescription() to swiftExperienceDescription() (and update the initializer to call swiftExperienceDescription()), or alternatively update the Client and the problem/template references to use getExperienceDescription(). Prefer fixing the solution to use swiftExperienceDescription() so it matches the problem statement and the provided template stub.

issues.description: The problem statement (and the template) require an instance method named `swiftExperienceDescription()` on the Developer class and instruct students to call it from the initializer and print its result. In the solution implementation, the method is implemented as `getExperienceDescription()` and the initializer calls `getExperienceDescription()` instead. This name mismatch means the solution uses a different identifier for the exact same conceptual method, which can confuse students when mapping the problem requirements to the solution (or when searching the solution for the expected method name).
issues.suggested_fix: Align the method name across all artifacts. Recommended: rename the solution method `getExperienceDescription()` to `swiftExperienceDescription()` and update its call in the initializer to `print(self.swiftExperienceDescription())`. Alternatively, if you prefer `getExperienceDescription()` as the canonical name, update the problem statement and template to reference `getExperienceDescription()` instead — but ensure all three artifacts use the same identifier.
